run_create_vasp_inputs_cli: run the create-vasp-inputs CLI to generate VASP input files from a directory of CIF structure files
create_input_generator_relax: create a RelaxSetGenerator with PBE_54_W_HASH functional and custom INCAR settings from a YAML file
create_input_generator_static: create a StaticSetGenerator with PBE_54_W_HASH functional and custom INCAR settings from a YAML file
read_cif_files_to_atoms: read CIF files from a directory using ASE and store them as atoms objects keyed by structure ID
write_vasp_input_set_from_structure: write VASP input files for a pymatgen Structure using an atomate2 input generator to an output directory
